Name: Purple Chickens
Author: StarriCakii
Description:
[center][color=#ffffff][b]This mod (or texture) only affects the Blue Chickens. [/b]


Hi there! This is my first mod so I hope you all like it!
I know this is really bland but I wanted to start easy so chickens were my first option. 
Let's get into this.




[b]BACKUP YOUR FILES! [/b]I don't want to be the one to make your blue chickens Purple forever. So do it! 

[size=3]What you want to do now Is put the XNB file into your "Animals" folder in Content (in your stardew valley folder). 
For me, I put it like this. [/size]
[size=4]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals 
[/size][size=3]Mainly take a look at the Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Animals . 
[/size]If you don't have Stardew Valley on Steam, I'm sorry ;; I'm not sure how to do it without steam. 
[/color][/center]
